mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meeting_minutes(meeting_minute_id, project_id, sub_task_id, member_id, title, content, created) SELECT SEQ_MEETING_MINUTES.NEXTVAL, #{projectId}, #{subTaskId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, SYSDATE FROM projects p JOIN sub_tasks st ON st.project_id = p.project_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND st.sub_task_id = #{subTaskId} AND st.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND pm.role IN (70, 50, 30, 10) )
mapper.select:
SELECT m.meeting_minute_id AS "meetingMinuteId", m.title, m.content AS "summary", TO_CHAR(m.meeting, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS "meetingDate", md.name AS "authorName" FROM meeting_minutes m JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = m.project_id LEFT OUTER JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = m.member_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL )
AND m.title LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%'
ORDER BY m.meeting DESC NULLS LAST, m.created DESC, m.meeting_minute_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT mm.meeting_minute_id AS "meetingMinuteId", mm.title, mm.content AS "content", TO_CHAR(mm.meeting, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS "meetingDate", md.name AS "authorName", CASE WHEN mm.member_id = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND pm.role IN (70, 50, 30) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "canModify" FROM meeting_minutes mm JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = mm.project_id LEFT OUTER JOIN member_details md ON md.member_id = mm.member_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND mm.meeting_minute_id = #{meetingMinuteId} AND mm.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL )

SELECT m.meeting_minute_id AS "meetingMinuteId", m.title FROM meeting_minutes m JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = m.project_id JOIN meeting_minutes c ON c.meeting_minute_id = #{meetingMinuteId} JOIN projects cp ON cp.project_id = c.project_id AND cp.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND c.deleted IS NULL AND ( m.created > c.created OR ( m.created = c.created AND m.meeting_minute_id > c.meeting_minute_id ) ) ) ORDER BY m.created ASC, m.meeting_minute_id ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT m.meeting_minute_id AS "meetingMinuteId", m.title FROM meeting_minutes m JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = m.project_id JOIN meeting_minutes c ON c.meeting_minute_id = #{meetingMinuteId} JOIN projects cp ON cp.project_id = c.project_id AND cp.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND m.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id AND wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.left IS NULL AND c.deleted IS NULL AND ( m.created < c.created OR ( m.created = c.created AND m.meeting_minute_id < c.meeting_minute_id ) ) ) ORDER BY m.created DESC, m.meeting_minute_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
